plan.summary: BRO-5508: record two nonprofit Broadway runs that switched to commercial runs. Ragtime (Lincoln Center Theater) played its first weeks under the LORT contract and became a commercial run the week of 2026-01-05; The Rocky Horror Show (Roundabout) turned into a commercial run in summer 2026 (date not yet reported). A converted run has investors, so both go from Nonprofit to TBD (outcome not announced; both keep humanReviewedDesignation). Appropriate (Hayes to a commercial run at the Belasco, 2024-03-25) is left for later: its record counts it recouped in 2024-03 by editorial judgment, which a same-month switch would contradict.
steps: Designation edits come before the conversion edits: commercial-record-checks.js refuses a commercialConversion on a Nonprofit designation.

actions.description: ragtime: Nonprofit -> TBD. A commercial run with investors since Jan 2026; no recoupment announced before it closed Aug 16, 2026.

ragtime: r/Broadway analyst, week ending Jan 4, 2026: 'This was also the final week under the LORT contract, show becomes a commercial run starting this week.' BroadwayWorld (Aug 27, 2026): it 'got to play by different rules for the first 16 weeks of their run'.
the-rocky-horror-show: Nonprofit -> TBD. Running as a commercial run with investors (the analyst publishes an estimated % recouped).
the-rocky-horror-show: r/Broadway analyst, week ending Aug 23, 2026: 'the best since the show turned into a commercial run'. Date not reported; the deep research prompts ask for it.
